entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'representative' to speak with an agent.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Bob. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. It's just... not what I expected.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Anya Sharma, and the order number is VF-8675309.
Thank you, Ms. Sharma. One moment... Okay, I see your order. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered 23 days ago. Let me just check the policy here...
Yep, you are well within the **90 days** for a return. **No problem** at all, I can get this started for you right away.
Oh, that's great. I was a little worried I had missed the window. Thank you.

Not at all. I'm processing that for you now. I've just sent the prepaid **return label** to the email on file. You should see it in the next 5 minutes. Just print that out, attach it to the box, and drop it at any post office.
And Ms. Sharma, I see you're a VeloFit VIP member. As a thank you for your loyalty, and for the trouble, I've gone ahead and added a $20 credit to your account for your next purchase with us.
Wow, you really didn't have to do that! That's very kind. Thank you, Bob.

It's my pleasure. We appreciate your business. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
You're very welcome. Have a great rest of your day and thank you for calling VeloFit.
